title: Auto-luminescence study of thermal unfolding of DNA G-quadruplexes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45628-45635
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04883D, Paper
Open Access

Vladislav Yu. Kudrya, Igor Ya. Dubey, Valentyna V. Negrutska, Antonina P. Naumenko
A novel low-temperature luminescence-based approach enables direct monitoring of the thermal unfolding of G-quadruplex DNA, revealing characteristic spectral signatures and providing new insights into its stability.
